source_metadata.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections
source_metadata.source_type: clinical guidance document / secondary evidence synthesis
source_metadata.extraction_scope: PDF pages 10-21 only; ESBL-E Section 1. Content above the Section 1 heading on page 10 (tail of Table 2) was intentionally excluded.

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom model is explicitly designed for primary literature, but this source is a clinical guidance document that synthesizes primary and secondary evidence. Atoms are therefore tagged guidance and secondary_source and remain needs_review.

Quantitative trial and surveillance results are reported here as evidence summaries within the guidance, not as results generated by the guidance publication itself; these atoms are tagged cited_evidence_summary.
The schema has no dedicated guideline recommendation atom kind. Panel recommendations were represented as author_conclusion rather than inventing a new type.

The schema has a single quantitative_result.estimate field; for multi-arm results, estimate represents the first reported arm proportion while arm-specific counts are preserved in quantitative_result.arms. No comparative effect size was invented.

For source-reported ranges without a single point estimate, the lower bound is stored in quantitative_result.estimate and the canonical statement preserves the full range; these atoms are tagged by context and should be reviewed before computational reuse.

Citations to underlying studies are retained only as tags such as cited_ref_82; bibliographic details were not parsed because the requested page scope ended at page 21 and excluded the reference list.
Extraction is limited to the ESBL-E content present on pages 10-21 and does not include the continuation of Question 1.7 on page 22.
